name: United Microelectronics Corporation
summary: United Microelectronics Corporation (UMC) functions as a leading semiconductor wafer foundry with an extensive international footprint, operating across Taiwan, Singapore, China, Hong Kong, Japan, the United States, and Europe, among other global regions. It offers a comprehensive suite of services encompassing circuit design, mask development, wafer manufacturing, and the crucial final stages of assembly and quality assurance testing. UMC primarily caters to the needs of fabless design firms and integrated device manufacturers. Founded in 1980, this enterprise maintains its corporate headquarters in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.
